page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.16xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the Intel Xeon 8269CY processor. Running on the KVM hypervisor, this instance features 64 dedicated physical cores and 64 vCPUs, operating at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The system provides 256.0 GB of RAM, resulting in a balanced memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per core.

This server configuration does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached block storage. For network connectivity, the instance delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps. The absence of hyperthreading ensures that each vCPU maps directly to a dedicated physical core, eliminating resource contention at the thread level.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated core allocation and high clock speed provide predictable compute performance for workloads that do not require GPU acceleration or local NVMe storage. The balanced 1:4 CPU-to-RAM ratio makes this instance appropriate for general-purpose enterprise applications, web serving, containerized deployments, and medium-scale database workloads that rely on network-attached storage.
